review_candidates.title: Cloud Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The opportunity: You'll join an experienced Cloud Operations team responsible for the infrastructure underpinning the company's SaaS platforms. The environment is already running in the cloud, but there is plenty of room to improve how things are built, maintained and automated. What you'll bring: Around 5 years of experience in complex infrastructure or cloud engineering environments. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, preferably using Azure DevOps and YAML.
eligibility_evidence: My client is a major international SaaS provider, serving more than 675,000 businesses worldwide.
Work on the cloud infrastructure behind a large-scale international SaaS business.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: What you'll bring: Around 5 years of experience in complex infrastructure or cloud engineering environments. Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, particularly IaaS environments.
